skill.name: Trace Metadata Update with Error Handling
skill.description: Safely update trace metadata with exception logging and boolean status return. Invoked when modifying trace attributes during agent execution and the caller needs explicit success or failure feedback.
skill.skill_body:
Attempt to update trace metadata (e.g., tags, status, custom fields). Wrap the update operation in a try-except block. On success, return True. On exception, log the error and return False. Do not suppress the exception; log it for debugging.

## Objective

Update trace metadata and return success status
## Applicable Signals

- Active trace session in progress
- Metadata attribute change requested
- Downstream caller expects boolean status

## Contraindications

- Trace is already closed or finalized
- Metadata is immutable or read-only
- Bulk metadata operations without retry logic

## Workflow Steps

- Receive metadata update request with target trace and attribute(s)
- Attempt metadata update operation
- On success: return True
- On exception: log error with logger.error() and return False

## Constraints

- Must wrap update in try-except block
- Must log exception before returning False
- Must return boolean (True/False) to caller

## Cautions

- Exception logging should include full error context for debugging
- Caller should not assume False return means trace is corrupted; only metadata update failed
- Do not use for transactional metadata updates requiring rollback

## Output Contract

- Boolean return value: True if metadata updated successfully; False if exception occurred and was logged. Caller uses return value to decide whether to retry, escalate, or continue.
